name: Sapphire Dragonborn
reviewNotes: This ordinary Gem leaf provides thunder affinity for the base Dragonborn Breath Weapon and 50% resistance.
Shared 15-foot cone, Psionic Mind and level-5 Gem Flight are inherited once from the nonselectable Gem family; base Breath Weapon action, dice progression, saves and resources remain unchanged.
No additional adaptation is invented solely to match Chromatic or Metallic leaves; category and skin material are expressed in its parent and authored ancestry identity.
No learned culture, language, alignment or Upbringing is automatically granted; Ruby is not a selectable ordinary Gem leaf.
